newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK restaurant receipts up five pct in value in 96'.
newsitem.headline: HK restaurant receipts up five pct in value in 96'.

text.p: Total restaurant receipts in Hong Kong were HK$55.3 billion in 1996, a five percent increase over 1995, provisional Census and Statistics Department data showed on Wednesday.
Receipts of bars increased by three percent in value and those of Chinese restaurants rose two percent.
Fast food outlets' receipts increased by 10 percent in value and those of non-Chinese restaurants grew by 11 percent.
In the fourth quarter of 1996, total restaurant receipts increased nine percent year-on-year to HK$14.6 billion.
